Cascadia 8, Color: Aquarius/Hibscs/BearingSea/Blk, Size: 5.0
The Cascadia 8 was designed from the gritty, wet, and uneven ground up. Engineered to adapt to the surface and your foot, this versatile piece of equipment runs an ultramarathon and then asks for more.
